sources.title: nsfw_image_detection: Image-to-Text model — overview, use cases ...
sources.snippet: nsfw_video_detectionby lucatacoextends NSFW detection to video frames, making it necessary if your use case involves video content. For static images alone, nsfw_image_detectionis simpler and more appropriate. If you need both images and videos in a unified pipeline, the video model handles both, though it introduces additional latency and cost.
